Senses.Explanation: The expression denotes with no handle to grasp in these Chan records. Its wording is there is no nose-handle: no projecting part by which the thing can be seized or led. Frozen-corpus concordance: 197 exact hits in 93 storage files representing 91 independent works. Chan records apply it to sayings, circumstances, people, and what a listener confronts. Dahui pairs it with 'no flavor' and says there is nothing to grasp when considering the dry shit-stick or the raised saying. Another record reverses the phrase into a place of inquiry: 'investigate until there is no handle; precisely where there is no handle is good to investigate.' Wuzhun plays the compound against the positive form, saying there is some handle and entirely no handle. This recurring use for the point at which a word or encounter supplies no graspable lead is the corpus-specific extension of the animal-handle image.
